verses.text: Then Job answered:
“How long are you going to torment me and crush me with your words?
Ten times now you’ve heaped insults on me. You’re not even ashamed to attack me.
Even if I really have gone wrong, that wrong is mine to carry.
If you’re set on making yourselves look bigger than me and using my disgrace as evidence against me,
then understand this: God has brought me down and closed his net around me.
“Look, I cry out, ‘I’ve been wronged!’ and nobody hears me. I call for help, and there’s no justice.
He’s walled off my road so I can’t get through. He’s put darkness on every path I take.
He’s stripped away my honor and taken the crown off my head.
He’s torn me down on every side, and I’m done for. He’s yanked up my hope like a tree.
He’s lit the fire of his anger against me and counts me as one of his enemies.
His troops come at me together, build a siege ramp against me, and camp all around my tent.
“He’s driven my brothers far from me. The people I used to know want nothing to do with me.
My relatives have gone away, and my close friends have forgotten me.
The people staying in my house and the women who serve there treat me like a stranger. I’m a foreigner to them.
I call my servant, and he doesn’t answer. I have to beg him myself.
My breath disgusts my wife. Even the children of my own mother can’t stand me.
Even little kids look down on me. When I get up, they talk against me.
All my close friends are disgusted with me. The people I loved have turned against me.
My bones stick to my skin and flesh. I’ve escaped by the skin of my teeth.
“Have pity on me! Have pity on me, my friends! God’s hand has touched me.
Why are you coming after me the way God does? Haven’t you had enough of my flesh?
“If only someone would write down my words! If only they were inscribed in a book!
If only they were carved into rock forever with an iron pen and lead!
But I know my Redeemer lives. In the end, he’ll stand on the earth.
After my skin is destroyed, I’ll see God in my flesh.
I’ll see him myself, on my side. I’ll see him with my own eyes, as someone I know. “My heart is worn out within me.
If you say, ‘We’re going to go after him,’ because you think I’m the root of the problem,
then be afraid of the sword. Anger brings punishment by the sword, and you’ll know there’s a judgment.”
